Follow existing patterns: TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind for styling, lucide-react for icons, React hooks for state, localStorage for client-side auth token storage.
key_patterns: 1. API client pattern: portalApi methods fetch from BACKEND_URL with Bearer token auth in headers. 2. Component pattern: Most pages use Container wrapper, rounded-2xl borders, shadow-sm, brand/immigration/marriage color tones. 3. Button pattern: Button component in src/components/ui/button.tsx accepts tone (brand/immigration/marriage/neutral) and variant (solid/outline). 4. Form pattern: Auth forms use email/password inputs with error display in red-50 boxes with AlertCircle icon.
